stem: A canopy practice worked well in one cultivar last cycle. What should govern use on a different cultivar and stage?
choices: The previous cultivar result is universal.
Social-media technique names override the work order.
Flowering stage is irrelevant to canopy response.
The current authorized work plan plus cultivar/stage-specific response evidence, not automatic copying of the prior result.
